title: Karyn E FDE 6174 NDE 6174
content: My experience was not like those that you usually read of. It was quite simple. I knew when the tire blew while I was on the Interstate that I was going to lose control of the car. I definitely heard a female voice say, 'there is nothing you can do,' and I felt the most serene feeling of total peace and absolutely no fear. I was knocked out after the first of four rolls. I did not see anyone or experience a tunnel but I did feel complete knowing and bliss. It was a feeling that honestly I cannot describe. I felt no fears, worries, or feelings of loss and I saw a white light surround me. I don't know if this would be considered a NDE but it was something that I cannot explain, especially the voice that sent me into this state of mind or whatever you would call it. I now have this gnawing feeling that I am supposed to know something or find something out something. I know how vague that sounds. I rather feel stupid sharing this because I totally don't understand it. I will forever remember the 'feeling'. So many times when I am confused and depressed about the whole thing, I get mad because I feel that I was cheated out of death, which I now consider complete serenity and peace. I do not have any thoughts of suicide by any means. Only so much confusion as to what I am supposed to 'do'.

arrival.other_being_detail: Heard a female voice say, 'there is nothing you can do,' but did not see anyone.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: After the experience, she had a persistent feeling she is supposed to know something or find something out and confusion about what she is supposed to 'do'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Tire blew on the Interstate; car rolled four times; she was knocked out after the first roll.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard a female voice; experienced total peace/no fear; 'complete knowing and bliss' without tunnel/figures.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or beings; voice and serene peace occurred immediately as the accident began; then she was knocked out.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience described as very simple: a female voice saying, 'there is nothing you can do,' followed by total peace/no fear and being surrounded by white light; no tunnel and no seen beings; later distress/confusion and feeling 'cheated out of death.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “there is nothing you can do,”; “the most serene feeling of total peace and absolutely no fear”; “I did feel complete knowing and bliss.”; “I saw a white light surround me.”; “I get mad because I feel that I was cheated out of death, which I now consider complete serenity and peace.”; “Only so much confusion as to what I am supposed to ‘do’.”
